target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, single newline characters (`\n`) are rendered as plain spaces by the Feishu IM API. This causes multi-paragraph prose to appear visually cramped. Fixes #97074 ## Why This Change Was Made Added `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines()` — a dedicated function that upgrades single `\n` to `\n\n` outside code regions for Feishu post+md rendering. It runs only after the render mode is known, so card and document-comment text are never modified. **Revision 6** (per ClawSweeper re-review — table conversion ordering): 1. **[P2] Convert tables before normalization in outbound post path** — `sendOutboundText` now resolves the table mode and runs `convertMarkdownTables` before `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines`. Normalization was inserting blank lines between table rows, which broke table row contiguity for the converter. Converting first preserves table structure for raw-mode Feishu accounts. `sendMessageFeishu` runs `convertMarkdownTables` again internally, but that is a no-op on already-converted text. This matches the `reply-dispatcher` `sendChunkedTextReply` path which already converted tables before normalization. **Revision 5** (per ClawSweeper re-review — single-pass normalization): 2. **[P2] Single-pass normalization for pre-chunked text** — Added `alreadyNormalized` flag to `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` and `sendMessageFeishu`. Callers that already normalized the full text before chunking pass `alreadyNormalized: true` so the payload builder skips `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines`. This prevents the second normalization pass from expanding code-block newlines when a chunk boundary falls inside a fenced region. 3. **[P2] Reply fanout for expanded subchunks** — Only the first subchunk carries the reply target. Later subchunks send without reply metadata so single-use implicit reply ids are consumed once per platform send. **Revision 4** (ClawSweeper review — three findings addressed): 4. **[P1] Card routing on raw text** — `sendOutboundText` routes `shouldUseCard(text)` on the original text before any normalization. 5. **[P2] Post-md rechunk after expansion** — After normalization, if text exceeds 4000 chars, `sendOutboundText` rechunks and sends each chunk as a separate post message. 6. **[P2] Edit-path length guard** — `editMessageFeishu` checks normalized length against the 4000-char limit before building the payload. ## User Impact - Post-md messages render with visible paragraph breaks instead of cramped single-spaced text - Card-mode and document-comment text is never modified - Single-pass normalization: pre-chunked subchunks are not re-normalized, code-block content split across chunk boundaries is preserved - Markdown tables are converted before normalization, preserving table rendering for raw-mode accounts - Reply fanout preserved: only the first expanded subchunk carries the reply target - Edit path rejects over-limit expanded content with a clear error ## Evidence - `pnpm test extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` — 164/164 passed - `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.json --quiet extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts` — clean - `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts` — clean - `pnpm build` — exit 0 (previous run) ### Real behavior proof Behavior addressed: card routing on raw text, post-md rechunk after expansion, edit-path length guard, reply fanout for subchunks, single-pass normalization for pre-chunked text, table conversion before normalization. Real environment tested: Linux (Node 24.13.1), branch `fix/97074-feishu-post-md-newline`, commit `799ca5277f`. Exact steps run: 1. Unit test suite (164 tests): includes `alreadyNormalized` flag tests, split-code-block regression, and table conversion ordering 2. Previous revision: Gateway started — Feishu WebSocket connected, direct API comparison of single-`\n` vs double-`\n` post-md messages **Screenshots**: comparison of single-`\n` vs double-`\n` post-md messages in Feishu client What was not tested: bot reply via gateway (Feishu error 230101 blocked DM replies), older Feishu client versions, live rechunk path, live edit-path limit rejection.
